newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas sinks midday with cash, forecasts.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas sinks midday with cash, forecasts.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures lost ground midday Thursday in active trade, with softer cash prices in the face of more seasonal weather forecasts undermining the complex, industry sources said.
At 1220 EDT, July slipped 3.7 cents to $2.19 per million British thermal units, while August was 5.8 cents lower at $2.155. Other deferreds were down by 1.2 to 6.3 cents.

"The shorts have covered, the stochastics were overdone to the upside and the (hot) forecasts are letting up," said one New York-based trader, adding bearish inventory data Wednesday also helped rouse the bears.
